sources.title: Next-permutation writer fixture plus actual-candidate exhaustive independent oracle

claims.text: The preserved source only names the next-permutation algorithm problem; API, in-place mutation, duplicate handling and maximum-to-minimum wraparound are answer-side contracts.

The actual candidate uses the rightmost improvable pivot, a smallest strictly greater successor from the non-increasing suffix, and suffix reversal to produce the immediate lexicographic successor under the stated contract.
Writer and independent executable checks cover duplicate values, strict comparisons, and the answer-side maximum-to-minimum wraparound contract.
The implementation performs bounded linear scans and one in-place suffix reversal while storing only indices and a temporary value, matching O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
